summary: Generates low-frequency oscillator waveforms in real time for non-audio motion and control signals, or repeats a prepared incoming source wave.
key_concepts: Generates low-frequency oscillator waves in real time for motion, control, and time-warping workflows.
Type selects a synthesized waveform unless the Source Wave input is connected, in which case the input curve replaces the waveform type.
Frequency is cycles per second, and the Octave Control input scales it exponentially by powers of two.
Reset input behavior depends on Reset Condition and can restart or hold the waveform at its beginning.
LFO CHOP is time-sliced and changes stepping speed as Frequency changes while it cooks.
Channel Name supports pattern expansion, and $C can vary per-channel parameters.

key_params.name: wavetype
key_params.note: Waveform shape: sine, Gaussian, triangle, ramp, square, or pulse

key_params.name: offset
key_params.note: Vertical offset added to the waveform

key_params.name: bias
key_params.note: Shape control for triangle, Gaussian, and square waves

key_params.name: resetcondition
key_params.note: How the Reset input restarts the oscillator

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Reset channel output to the beginning while on

key_params.name: resetpulse
key_params.note: Instantly reset channel output to the beginning

key_params.name: channelname
key_params.note: Output channel names or expansion pattern

common_gotchas: Source Wave input disables the waveform Type choice and repeats the incoming multi-sample curve.
Octave Control is exponential: +1 doubles frequency, +2 quadruples it, and -1 halves it.
Reset input is interpreted as off/on using <=0 and >0 and depends on Reset Condition.
Bias only shapes triangle, Gaussian, and square waves.
LFO CHOP is designed for non-audio frequencies; use Audio Oscillator CHOP for audio-rate oscillation.
Sine and triangle outputs are -1 to 1 by default, while Gaussian and ramp outputs are 0 to 1.
